In 2023 every country where a newborn could expect fewer than 60 years of life was in sub-Saharan Africa

Period life expectancy at birth, years, 2023 — 229 countries drawn, 12 territories with no reading

6065707580+

No reading

The 6, lowest first: Nigeria, Chad, Lesotho, Central African Republic, South Sudan and Somalia — 54.5 to 58.8 years

Japan 84.7 is the highest reading big enough to point at; Monaco 86.4, the file's highest, is under a pixel at this scale

Period life expectancy is not a forecast: it is the years a newborn would live if the chances of dying at each age stayed exactly as they were in 2023. Monaco holds the highest reading in the file and is under a pixel here — the table carries it, and every other country drawn. Eight territories the source reports separately are drawn nowhere and are in no table on this page: Natural Earth folds each of them into the state that administers it.
